ety.text: Etymology tree Proto-Indo-European *h₁én Proto-Indo-European *-tḗr Proto-Indo-European *-trom Proto-Indo-European *h₁éntrom Proto-Indo-Iranian *Hántram Proto-Indo-Aryan *Hántram Sanskrit अन्त्र (antra) Proto-Indo-European *h₁én Proto-Indo-European *h₁ontróm Proto-Indo-Iranian *Hāntrám Proto-Indo-Aryan *Hāntrám Sanskrit आ॒न्त्र (āntrá) Prakrit 𑀅𑀁𑀢 (aṃta) Hindi आँत Inherited from Prakrit 𑀅𑀁𑀢 (aṃta), from Sanskrit अन्त्र (antra) or आ॒न्त्र (āntrá). ety.text: From बोलना (bolnā) + -आना (-ānā). Compare the past participle बोल्लाविय (bollāviya, “said”).
Inherited from Sanskrit मुद्गगिरि (mudgagiri), a compound of मुद्ग (mudga, “mung bean”) + गिरि (giri, “mountain, hill”).

Inherited from Sanskrit लङ्गति (laṅgati, “láṅgati”) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀟- (-ḍa-). Related to लंगड़ा (laṅgṛā). Cognate with Gujarati લંગડાવું (laṅgḍāvũ), Punjabi ਲੰਗੜਾਉਣਾ (laṅgṛāuṇā), Marathi लंगडणे (laṅgaḍṇe).
